name: Scenario 1: Notes Share Dialog Regression Fixture

mockData.isolationGuarantee: Deterministic offline mock. No HTTP requests, no emails sent, no mutation of persistent storage.

bareHeadingEscalation.defect: Bare h2 element without class in NotesComponents.tsx:308 receives global section title typography rule from typography.css:52 (font-size: var(--font-section-title-size)), expanding font-size to 48px clamp instead of dialog title ~20px.

flexboxFieldSqueeze.defect: In Notes.module.css:655, .shareLine is display: flex; gap: 8px. The input has flex: 1. forms.css unlayered rules set input, select { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: var(--space-4); } while reset.css sets * { min-width: 0; }. Inside the 420px fixed dialog, select padding-right: 3rem and unconstrained flex cause email field and select dropdown to compete and squeeze.
flexboxFieldSqueeze.targetContract: Proper flex-basis or explicit width contract (e.g. flex-shrink: 0 for select or grid-based layout) without unlayered forms.css inflation.

actionButtonHierarchy.defect: Notes.module.css:623 applies .modal button { background: var(--color-brand); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; ... } uniformly across all 3 dialog buttons (Share with user, Copy Link, Done), destroying visual hierarchy between primary, secondary, and dismissal actions.
actionButtonHierarchy.baselineStyling: All 3 buttons render with identical primary brand background
actionButtonHierarchy.targetContract: Visual hierarchy: primary accent for Share, subtle/outline for Copy Link, ghost/tertiary for Done.
